reviews.text: My second ever visit and like a port-in-a-storm for a 'first puppy' owner. Really patient and knowledgeable advice, all my questions answered - despite a steady flow of dogs and their owners picking up and dropping off for a trim. It really spurred me on in what felt like a 'bitey puppy fog' and I bought some great treats - from Hound Hut's fantastic and healthy range - to help smooth the way forward.
Awesome service and always friendly. The staff take good care of Max and he's always excited to be there.

I've been a customer for a few years now. Great range of healthy products as well as various toys and accessories. But the grooming is the highlight - just got back from there, they've turned my ewok into a dog again! She loves going there and always comes out a happy, wagging dog.

Mango and I love the hound hut!!!! He used to be so scared of the groomers but after a few visits here, all his fears have gone away. All the groomers are so gentle and nice with him and he always leaves looking so clean, polished and happy! <3
Great selection, great grooming. I would highly recommend to anyone.

Nelly had his first groom in a while here as we’d not had the best experience elsewhere. Can safely say that he was well looked after and has come home looking very handsome! Grateful to have found somewhere that was so friendly and professional, especially with Nelly being a rescue. Will happily commute and make this our regular spot. Thank you!
This shop is stocked! They’ve got everything and more you could want for your dog. Beautiful leads in every colour, rain coats, treats galore. Bring your dog with you when you go! It’s a delight

I have been visiting the shop with my two pugs now for over three years now. They have a wide variety of dog food,/treats, toys and products in beautiful and welcoming surroundings. Plus you an order online.

Anthony, Rob (the owners) and their staff always welcome us with a 😀 smile. I recommend the doggy grooming and day care facilities too. Helen
Great grooming service my dog looks lovely

This is what my dog Monty tells me:
The Hound Hut is positively my favourite pet shop. The staff are exceptional and the selection is inspired. The grooming services are a real highlight. I can't wait to go back.

Anytime I'm taking my 3 cockapoos there, Lisa is so nice and so friendly, it's such a pleasure to see her everytime and Natalia is doing such a good job on my 3 babies. They always looking well groomed All the time I've been there, I've never been disappointed, I would recommend to everyone who's looking for a groomer to visit them and see for yourself.

Paw tidy + nail trim. My dog loves the team here and always comes back looking smart. Friendly and professional service and loads of great treats for my dog. Amazing to have such a good service locally. A*

Extremely NOT RECOMMENDED! Horrible Experience and trauma for Our Puppy. STAY AWAY!

⚠️Update: As requested, I've sent the booking details privately and confirm I wrote to the right store. Their initial response—publicly doubting the review rather than addressing the complaint—was disappointing. Added 3 new photos showing that, three days later, the split nails had completely fallen off. The diagonal break has now exposed the entire, long quick. ⚠️Final update:The business has officially responded below. Please be aware of their strategy:
1. They have denied all responsibility. Their “thorough investigation” concluded that their service was perfect.
2. They have blamed us, the owners. They claim a “professional veterinary opinion” states the severe, symmetrical damage to multiple nails was caused by my dog “scratching or digging” after a short leash walk home, where she then slept. This is not only scientifically absurd but a defamatory attempt to shift blame.
3. They ignored all factual rebuttals.
4. Their “open invitation” is a PR stunt designed to distract from the specific, documented injury. They would not address how it happened under their care.⚠️

We have a 16kg young dog who has had successful baths and nail trims at other groomers without any issue. We tried this nearby shop for the first time based on a recommendation, hoping for convenience. It was an absolute nightmare and a traumatic experience for our young dog.

1. Grossly Incompetent, Borderline Abusive Nail Trimming
When we got home and tried to wipe her paws, our puppy was unusually sensitive and resistant—whimpering and pulling away. Upon close inspection, I was horrified and heartbroken. Her nails were butchered:

· At least 3 nails were cut soooo short they bled. The quick was clearly cut into, with thick vessel exposed, with visible blood and residue!!!!!!
· At least 5 other nails were cut right to the very edge of the quick, leaving only a dangerous sliver of pink before the blood vessel.
· Nearly every single nail was left ragged and split!!!!! I have never seen nails splintered from a trim, especially on a puppy with softer nails! Do they not have proper, sharp tools? This reeks of using dull clippers and rushed, impatient staff with no patience for a young dog.
· Her nails are white/clear, making the quick perfectly visible. There is zero excuse for this many cuts and such shoddy work on a puppy. This is foundational grooming that they failed at catastrophically.

2. Complete Lack of Transparency
Most alarmingly, when I picked her up, the staff said NOTHING about the nails. They did not inform me that there had been any bleeding, nor did they apologize or offer any aftercare advice. This shows a complete lack of professionalism and accountability. Hiding an injury caused by their negligence is unacceptable.

3. Distressing After-Effects on My Puppy
My normally energetic, curious puppy came home lethargic, subdued, and has been sleeping constantly (very abnormal for her age). She is extremely sensitive and fearful about us touching her paws (also very abnormal). She can't tell us she's in pain, but her behavior screams it. We are heartbroken and furious. This isn't just a bad groom; this is causing physical pain and potentially creating a lasting fear of nail trims and groomers for a young, impressionable dog.

Conclusion:
This establishment demonstrated a shocking lack of professionalism, basic skill, empathy, and care for animal welfare. They caused injury, failed to disclose it, wasted my time, and traumatized my young dog. I would not trust them with any animal. RUN. Save your money and, more importantly, spare your pet this awful experience that could impact them for life. We will never return and will be warning all local pet owners.
This is no longer about a bad review. It’s about a business that, when faced with clear evidence of harm, chose to attack the customer’s credibility rather than conduct a genuine investigation. Let their response inform your judgement.

We absolutely love the Hound Hut! All four of my dogs adore visiting — so much so that when we’re walking through Kennington Park, they try to drag me straight to the shop. They just can’t wait for their grooming day!

The staff are all wonderful, warm, and genuinely caring. Emily, Holly, and Natalia are all fantastic groomers. They always take such great care of my pups and make them look wonderful every single time.

The owners, Rob and Anthony, are amazing — welcoming, dedicated, and always creating such a positive, cheerful atmosphere in the shop.

Our oldest, Stanley, is 14 years old, and he still loves going in — he happily gives everyone big kisses the moment he walks through the door.

The Hound Hut is simply the best, and we couldn’t imagine going anywhere else!

Picked up my dogs last night after Anthony kindly arranged an appointment at last minute for a Christmas groom - Holly as always was superb, one of my dogs is reactive but she knows him and is very good with him so we always go with her - such a lovely shop and owners - fully recommend
